subject: reasoning
question:
Select the dice that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/264e331e5fc328ac3b0b3f6015bbf594de7f2e771c6a40a53a9484e8962df1f0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76bb9e3e60c4c874e5cb15b4b0542dcfb5471d8e40a27a042467decb3de73237.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is: 

The opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surfaces are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

In the given figure, Opposite faces are :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fad01c4359fd3154437167b09aff803a9202f662b599c8b126a29a20ccd53217.png] 

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dccf5d5cc0ab50fc971a1d43b54abcefafaccc93537f9dd0d9954cf1e30d3636.png] → The two sides should be opposite to each other but given adjacent to each other.

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6664d27339496d9b5f18bb99ff0e446e8348a0a2fe0f1a07a8ec23366005270c.png] → Here all three sides adjacent to each other.

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b40573922248a22e87d45571eb7532ade2c9a43a80393f8d2e07fb09c1f1034.png] → The two sides should be opposite to each other but given adjacent to each other.

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d8693574ec9c3bb45865c812b32c08b3eadd3a54b0b07ae7103954805a6c852.png] → The two sides should be opposite to each other but given adjacent to each other.

∴ Here, only cube B is formed by folding the given sheet.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only B".**
